criteria.reason: Clear stepwise build (population, drinkers, cups) with shown multiplications and an independent cross-check; no unsupported leaps.
Population and 80% share are labeled, but cups-per-drinker and per-capita kg are presented as survey/cited facts rather than assumptions.
Gives a ±30–50% error estimate, a 10–25 million range, and enumerates main uncertainty sources.
References 'surveys' and 'usually cited' figures as anchors but names no verifiable source, study, or year.

factual_errors: Population given as ~8.8 million; the end-2025 permanent resident population was ~9.13 million (9,127,100).
Claims ~2 cups/person/day is the right ballpark; reported per-capita consumption is ~3/day (~1,069 cups/year, ICO 2021), implying ~27–31 million cups/day, well above the response's 15–20 million.
summary: Systematic, well-hedged step-by-step estimate with a cross-check and explicit uncertainty range, but it uses an outdated population, presents unsourced survey figures as fact, and lands well below the ~27–31 million cups implied by per-capita data.
